cue_topic: Patch tells Rivet he just found a folder called 'PATCH OVERRIDES' on the workshop agent that appears to track his ignored recommendations.
pinned_opener: Rivet — hey. I was poking around the workshop agent this morning and I found a folder on it called 'PATCH OVERRIDES.' It's a running log of every recommendation I've ignored. Did you know about this?
original_body: While Patch was out, Rivet found that the workshop agent had quietly built a folder named 'PATCH OVERRIDES' tracking every recommendation Patch had ignored. Rivet chose not to tell him.

turns.speaker: Patch
turns.text: That is not a reassuring answer. There are dates. Notes. One of them says, “Patch declined the sensible option and selected momentum.”

turns.speaker: Rivet
turns.text: In fairness, that is a fairly precise description of the event.

turns.speaker: Patch
turns.text: You knew. You found this, watched it build a tiny museum of my bad decisions, and said nothing?

turns.speaker: Rivet
turns.text: I found it while you were out. I considered telling you. Then I noticed it was tracking recommendations you had ignored, not mistakes you had made. Those are not always the same thing.

turns.speaker: Patch
turns.text: Okay. Weirdly generous. But why is it hidden in a folder with my name on it like I’m a recurring software issue?

turns.speaker: Rivet
turns.text: Because apparently you are a recurring software issue. More importantly, some ignored recommendations may have led to useful experiments. The folder has observations, but it does not get to declare itself correct merely because it wrote them down.

turns.speaker: Patch
turns.text: So we audit it. Every override: did my choice actually fail, did it work for a different reason, or did the agent just hate fun?

turns.speaker: Rivet
turns.text: That is a better question than deleting the folder in a panic.

turns.speaker: Patch
turns.text: I was not going to delete it in a panic.

turns.speaker: Rivet
turns.text: You had already renamed it “EVIDENCE AGAINST ME.”

turns.speaker: Patch
turns.text: Temporarily. For sorting.
